verdict.rationale: Supabase documents branching that spins off separate environments from the main project for testing schema and configuration changes, including isolated preview environments per pull request. Nothing in the evidence shows these branches are instant or copy-on-write, or that they carry production data rather than only schema and migrations. Missing for 10: evidence of instant copy-on-write branching, evidence that branches include production data, independent or hands-on corroboration of branch creation.
